resolutions.title: /opsx:verify-change naming drift (skill name leaked into slash-command invocations)
resolutions.action: Mechanical replacement: `/opsx:verify-change <name>` → `/opsx:verify <name>` across 6 occurrences. The skill name `openspec-verify-change` is preserved where it's actually the skill being referenced (vs the slash-command invocation, which is `/opsx:verify`). Per codex's recommendation: 'reserve `openspec-verify-change` for the skill name.'

resolutions.title: Archive-summary paths missing the YYYY-MM-DD- date prefix that upstream's archive move adds
resolutions.action: Updated all orbit-additions references to the archived location to use the dated form `openspec/changes/archive/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<change-name>/.orbit-runs/`, matching upstream Step 5's `mv` target. Added clarifying notes that the date prefix is added by upstream's archive move step. Updates span 10 occurrences across SKILL, references/, command body, spec, tasks, design, README, CLAUDE.md.

resolutions.title: address-reviews flag surface inconsistent across README / command body / SKILL / spec
resolutions.action: User chose option (a): drop `--list` and `--only` from README + command body as redundant with the positional `<scope>` argument (which already accepts paths, globs, and change names). `--list` (preview-only) deferred to v2 per issue #3 — YAGNI for lean v1 (D6). Updated README's Flags table, command body's Flags section, and tasks.md task 6.4 description to reflect the cut.

resolutions.title: External-findings parser contract has ambiguity: prompt-template uses `...` ellipsis; empty-section sentinel undocumented
resolutions.action: Expanded prompt-template.md's WARNING and SUGGESTION sections to show the full `### <Title>` + `**File**:` + `**Description**:` triple shape (replacing the `...` ellipsis). Added explicit guidance to use `None.` as the empty-section sentinel. Also added a 'Tolerated variations' entry to external-findings-format.md documenting `None.` (and the case-insensitive variants `None` / `none.` / `(none)`) as the empty-severity sentinel. Added a quick worked-example block to external-findings-format.md citing this very codex run as the real-world reference.

resolutions.title: README install-verify claims modified skills show `openspec-orbit` in metadata.author; actual files preserve upstream `author: openspec`
resolutions.action: User chose option (a): drop the author-change claim from README; rely on the presence of the `## Orbit additions` section appended at the bottom of each modified SKILL.md as the verification signal. This preserves the 'purely additive, upstream content + frontmatter metadata verbatim' design property rather than mutating upstream metadata.
